The '''Sarrahban system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cyrillian Protectorate/Legends|Cyrillian Protectorate]], situated in [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA-OC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrahban]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the system was a source of stabilized [[ytterbium]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="TRG1-115" />
